question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Bewitching
solution: The correct answer is **"Alluring."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Bewitching"** means having a captivating or enchanting effect. (मनोरम या मंत्रमुग्ध करने वाला प्रभाव रखने वाला) • **Example**: *He was mesmerized by her **bewitching**__ green eyes.* • **"Alluring"** is a synonym for **bewitching.** • It means attractive or enticing. (रहस्‍यमय ढंग से लुभावना व मोहक) __ • **Example**: *She has an **alluring**__ smile.* • The correct answer is Option 2. __ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__ • **Painful** means causing physical or emotional discomfort. (दर्द या पीड़ा उत्‍पन्‍न करने वाला; पीड़ादायी) • **Rude** means lacking manners or being impolite. (अशिष्‍ट (किसी के प्रति) (किसी बात पर)) • **Repulsive **means causing disgust or aversion. (घोर नफ़रत पैदा करने वाला; घृणास्‍पद) 35:T456, The correct answer is **"No correction required."**
